title: Master Pro Puff
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: An ultra-soft velour makeup puff that applies powder with precision to your under-eyes and face—for a flawless, soft-focus finish.

Brush Formulation: Loose Powder

Brush Coverage: Buildable

Ingredient Callouts: This product is cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This tear-drop-shaped, velour powder puff is ideal for applying the SurrealSkin™ Soft Blur Setting Powder (sold separately) to your under-eyes and face, with a custom density designed by Mario. Made for professional performance, the Master Pro Puff is washable, dual-sided, and has a reversible ribbon for maximum usage.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Press and roll powder into skin for a smooth-looking complexion.
-Fold and rub powder into puff for a more even application.

Care:
-Gently hand wash using mild soap.
-Let sit to dry.
